senses.gloss: रकार ra-kāra, m. the letter r.
रक्क rakka, m. N..
रक्ति rak-ti, f. attachment, to (lc.): -mat, 🞄a. charming, lovely.
रक्तिमन् rakt-i-man, m. redness.
रक्तीकृ raktī-kṛ, colour red.
रक्तोत्पल rakta‿utpala, n. red lotus (Nymphaea 🞄rubra).

रक्षपाल rakṣa-pāla, m. guard, watchman: 🞄-ka, m. id.;
 i-kā, f. female guard.
राक्षोघ्न rākṣoghná, a. (ī) treating of the 🞄demon-slaying verses (rakṣoghna).

रक्ष्य rakṣ-ya, fp. to be guarded, — preserved, 🞄— taken care of, — cherished, from 🞄(ab.);
 — guarded against or avoided: -tama, 🞄spv. to be most carefully guarded.
राक्षसी rākṣas-ī, f. female Rākṣasa or 🞄demon.

राक्षसीकृ rākṣasī-kṛ, turn into a Rākṣasa;
 🞄-bhū, be turned into a Rākṣasa.

राक्षसेन्द्र rākṣasa‿indra, m. prince of Rākṣasas, 🞄sp. ep. of Rāvaṇa;
 -īśvara, m. id..
